definition: to go and bring something back
description: A wet golden retriever trots out of the shallow waves on a grey sandy beach on an overcast day, dragging a big pink inflatable flamingo by its head in its mouth. A laughing young woman with wet hair, a cream knitted jumper and a black swimsuit waits at the water's edge with her arms spread wide. The dog brings the flamingo up to her, she crouches down, and she hugs the dog while the flamingo lies on the sand beside them. Small waves roll in behind.

taps.phrase: to hug the soaking wet dog
